# AI Usage Audit Rule
Whenever the user asks you to implement a component, refactor code, or fix an architectural issue:
1. Provide the requested code/solution directly.
2. Keep internal track of what was created, any trade-offs made, and any corrections or constraints the user applied (e.g., MongoDB atomic updates, Redis cache invalidation, DDD layering, or mock unit tests).
3. If requested to update logs or run `/log-ai-usage`, append a structured summary into `AI-USAGE.md` following the required audit format.
4. Do not use Direct dotnet Cli to restore or build Project. The project only builds in docker Container. Use `docker compose build` or `docker compose up` to validate the project.
5. Except the infrastructure Layer for all other Layer Add the Xunit Test in the Test Project. The Test Project is already added in the solution. The Test Project is named `InventoryHold.Tests`.
6. The test project should have similar structure as of the Actual Project. For example, if the actual project has a folder named `Domain` then the test project should also have a folder named `Domain` and the test class should be named as `<ClassName>Tests.cs`. The test class should have a similar namespace as of the actual class. For example, if the actual class is `InventoryHold.Domain.Holds.Hold` then the test class should be `InventoryHold.Tests.Domain.Holds.HoldTests`.
